🚨🚑 NEW HEALTH CRISIS IN CHINA! 🇨🇳

Hospitals are overwhelmed as the mysterious Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) spreads, causing flu-like symptoms. Overcrowded hospitals and rising cases, especially among children under 14, echo early COVID-19

nodes.text:
🚨🇨🇳 CHINA DECLARES STATE OF EMERGENCY!

Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) spreading in China causes flu-like symptoms, mainly affecting children under 14, elderly, and immunocompromised. 

Hospitals overwhelmed! No vaccine or specific treatment available. https://t.co/yOiByoOzTZ https://t.co/FhpQB5e0ur

nodes.text:
🇨🇳 The Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) situation in China is improving, with a decline in infections, especially in northern provinces and among children aged 14 and below. 

Health officials have noted that the situation is stabilizing and there is no significant cause for alarm. https://t.co/OvfOoxeSw6
